summary_en: This study compares two imaging methods, FLT PET and chemical shift-encoded MRI (CSE-MRI), to look at bone marrow in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who are scheduled to receive 177Lu-PSMA therapy. FLT is given as an intravenous injection of up to 10 mCi (370 MBq), with PET imaging about one hour later, and each imaging session lasts 2 to 3 hours. The study's main goal is to see whether CSE-MRI is as accurate as FLT PET at telling active bone marrow from inactive bone marrow; it is an early phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara dos métodos de imagen, la PET con FLT y la resonancia magnética con codificación por desplazamiento químico (CSE-MRI), para observar la médula ósea en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración que están programados para recibir terapia con 177Lu-PSMA. El FLT se administra como inyección intravenosa de hasta 10 mCi (370 MBq), con imágenes PET aproximadamente una hora después, y cada sesión de imagen dura de 2 a 3 horas. El objetivo principal es ver si la CSE-MRI es tan precisa como la PET con FLT para distinguir la médula ósea activa de la inactiva; es un estudio de fase 1 temprana.
who_for: Prostate cancer confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
Metastatic PSMA-positive castration-resistant prostate cancer, scheduled for 177Lu-PSMA therapy.
Clinically appropriate for standard Lu-177 PSMA therapy, with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Able to lie flat for at least 30 minutes during imaging.
not_for: Receiving any ongoing therapy that affects bone marrow, such as G-CSF.
Side effects from prior treatment not yet resolved to grade 2 or lower (CTCAE v5).
Uncontrolled illness, such as active infection, symptomatic heart failure, unstable angina, or arrhythmia.
Psychiatric or social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements, per the treating physician.
